data.title: Paula G gave Lulu and Georgia 3 stars. Check out the full review...
data.content:
* * *

![Image 1: Rated 3 out of 5 stars](https://cdn.trustpilot.net/brand-assets/4.1.0/stars/stars-3.svg)

Jun 24, 2026

## [Vase was mostly as described](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a3bcbde999ba0cb7947d521)
Vase was mostly as described, other than surface is somewhat gritty to the touch. Disappointing to get it with the shipping box significantly damaged by large gash that sliced completely thru cardboard. Because the vase only had styrofoam protection at the top & bottom, it’s amazing that it wasn’t broken by whatever caused the gash. A single strip of clear packing tape was very loosely placed over the gash. Took about a week for delivery.

June 11, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jun 24, 2026

Hi Paula,

Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear the package arrived with visible damage to the shipping box. We understand how concerning that must have been, especially for a fragile item, and we're relieved the vase arrived intact.

We also appreciate your comments about the vase's texture and will share your feedback with our team as we continue to improve both our products and packaging experience.

Thank you for shopping with Lulu and Georgia.
